```{r fetch-data}
# 1. Get FED Funds Rate from FRED (uses your fredr_set_key)
fed_funds <- fredr(
  series_id = "FEDFUNDS",
  observation_start = as.Date("1999-01-01"),
  observation_end = as.Date("2024-12-31")
) %>%
  select(date, value) %>%
  rename(fed_funds_rate = value)

# 2. Function to fetch BLS data (uses your bls_api_key)
fetch_bls_data <- function(series_id, start_year, end_year, api_key = NULL) {
  payload <- list(
    'seriesid' = series_id,
    'startyear' = start_year,
    'endyear' = end_year
  )
  
  if (!is.null(api_key)) {
    payload$registrationkey <- bls_api_key  # Your BLS key gets used here
  }
  
  response <- blsAPI(payload, api_version = 2)
  
  df <- response %>%
    mutate(
      month_num = as.numeric(gsub("M", "", period)),
      date = as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month_num, "-01")),
      value = as.numeric(value)
    ) %>%
    select(date, value) %>%
    arrange(date)
  
  return(df)
}

# 3. Fetch CPI and Unemployment data (passes your bls_api_key to the function)
cpi_data <- fetch_bls_data('CUUR0000SA0', '1999', '2024', bls_api_key) %>%
  rename(cpi = value)

unemp_data <- fetch_bls_data('LNS14000000', '1999', '2024', bls_api_key) %>%
  rename(unemployment = value)

# 4. Fetch Unemployment data
# Series ID: LNS14000000
unemp_data <- fetch_bls_data('LNS14000000', '1999', '2024', bls_api_key) %>%
  rename(unemployment = value)

# 5. Merge all datasets
economic_data <- fed_funds %>%
  full_join(cpi_data, by = "date") %>%
  full_join(unemp_data, by = "date") %>%
  arrange(date)

# Calculate Year-over-Year inflation rate
economic_data <- economic_data %>%
  mutate(
    cpi_yoy = (cpi / lag(cpi, 12) - 1) * 100,  # Year-over-year inflation %
    year = year(date),
    quarter = quarter(date),
    month = month(date)
  )

# View the combined data
glimpse(economic_data)
summary(economic_data)
```
